legal.privacyBody:
Last updated: June 2026

Status Daily ("we", "our", "the app") respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have.

1. Information we collect
• Mobile number — used only to create your account and sign you in.
• Profile details — the name, photo, language and bio you choose to add. Your photo stays on your device and is only used to create your status; we do not upload it to build a profile of you.
• Usage data — which templates you open, save and share, so we can show better content. This is linked to your account in a minimal form.
• Device information — app version, device model and operating system, used for stability and support.

2. How we use your information
We use it to run the app, personalize your status designs, improve our templates, keep your saved items in sync, and respond to support requests. We do not sell your personal data.

3. Sharing
We share data only with service providers who help us operate the app (for example, SMS delivery and hosting), and only as needed to provide the service. We may disclose information if required by law.

4. Storage and security
We keep your data only as long as your account is active. We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect it. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Your choices
You can edit your profile at any time, change your language, or delete your account from Settings. Deleting your account removes your profile and associated data from the app.

6. Children
Status Daily is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

7. Changes
We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected here with a new date.

8. Contact
Questions? Write to support@statusdaily.app.
legal.termsBody:
Last updated: June 2026

Welcome to Status Daily. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these Terms.

1. Your account
You must provide a valid mobile number and accurate profile details. You are responsible for activity on your account. You must be at least 13 years old to use Status Daily.

2. Using the app
Status Daily lets you personalize and share status images and videos for your own personal, non-commercial use. You agree not to misuse the app, including: uploading unlawful, hateful, obscene or infringing content; impersonating others; attempting to disrupt or reverse-engineer the service; or using it to harass anyone.

3. Content
The templates, designs, fonts and artwork in the app are owned by us or our licensors and are provided for use within the app. The photo and text you add remain yours; by using the app you confirm you have the right to use them. You are solely responsible for the status you create and share.

4. Premium features
Some features may require a paid subscription or purchase. Pricing and what is included are shown before you pay. Purchases are also subject to our Refund & Cancellations policy and the rules of the app store you bought through.

5. Availability
We work to keep the app running but provide it "as is" without warranties. We may add, change or remove features, and may suspend accounts that violate these Terms.

6. Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law, Status Daily is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.

7. Changes
We may update these Terms. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

8. Contact
For any questions about these Terms, write to support@statusdaily.app.
legal.refundBody:
Last updated: June 2026

This policy applies to paid purchases and subscriptions made in Status Daily.

1. Subscriptions
Premium subscriptions are billed in advance for the period you choose (for example, monthly or yearly). Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel before the renewal date.

2. Cancellations
You can cancel anytime from your app store subscription settings (Google Play or the App Store). When you cancel, you keep premium access until the end of the current paid period; you are not charged again after that.

3. Refunds
Payments are processed by the app store you purchased through, and refunds are handled under that store's policy. If you believe you were charged in error or have not received what you paid for, contact us within 7 days of the charge and we will review your request and assist with the store where applicable.

4. One-time purchases
One-time purchases (such as a content pack) are generally non-refundable once the content has been delivered, except where required by law or the app store's rules.

5. How to reach us
For billing questions or refund help, write to support@statusdaily.app with your registered mobile number and the date of the charge.

faq.q1: How do I create a status?
faq.a1: Open the Home tab, pick any template you like, then add your name and photo. Tap Edit to adjust the look, then Download or Share — your status is ready in seconds.
faq.q2: How do I add my photo and name?
faq.a2: On the personalize screen, tap Change Photo to choose a picture from your gallery and type your name in the name field. You can drag the photo and text to position them exactly how you want.
faq.q3: How do I share to WhatsApp?
faq.a3: After your status is ready, tap Share and choose WhatsApp. You can also tap Download to save it to your gallery and share it later from anywhere.
faq.a4: Everything you save appears in the Saved tab. Tap any saved card to edit it again or share it instantly.
faq.q5: How do I change the app language?
faq.a5: Go to Settings → Change Language and pick from English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam. The whole app updates instantly.
faq.a6: Yes — you can browse templates and create statuses for free. Some premium templates and features may need a paid plan, and you'll always see the price before you pay.
faq.q7: What do I get with Premium?
faq.a7: Premium removes the daily limits and lets you share and download statuses with your own photo, plus access to premium templates. Free users can always create and share name-only statuses within the daily limit.
faq.q8: What are the plans and prices?
faq.a8: There are three plans — a ₹2 trial for 7 days, ₹59 per month, and ₹499 per year (best value). You can start from the Upgrade screen in Settings or your Profile.
faq.a9: When you subscribe, you approve a UPI AutoPay mandate so renewals happen automatically. If you don't have UPI, we show a QR code that a family member can scan and approve on your behalf. You're only charged the plan amount shown.
faq.q10: How do I cancel my subscription or AutoPay?
faq.a10: Open your Profile → Subscription and tap Cancel AutoPay. Your Premium access stays active until the end of the current period, and you won't be charged again. You can also manage the mandate from your UPI app.
